SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.dish_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, r.rating, r.content, r.images AS images_json, r.created_at, r.useful_count AS useful_count FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.dish_id = #{dishId} AND r.is_hidden = 0
AND r.images IS NOT NULL AND r.images != '' AND r.images != '[]'
ORDER BY r.useful_count DESC, r.created_at DESC ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
